authorization_scope_at_publication: Publish P11 review and P12 plan; implementation/server launch follow the supplied Codex prompt. Publishing does not start training.
objective: Full resume P11 residual36000; compare WM fitting k8/k16 with Actor H32. Assess live-prefix prediction, difficult skills, general quality and LAFAN retention.
acceptance: LAFAN full40 normalized return>=0.82 was accepted as reproduced. P12 does not revoke that result or add acceptance requirements.

established: P11 height constraint was correctly implemented, but overall return and fixed-input WM accuracy declined; use its residual parent.
Residual WM errors grow at live steps8-16; report errors after survival vanishes separately.
Hard clips and effective k8 start bins reached the learner; exposure does not establish accurate critical-phase dynamics.
limits: Seven fixed inputs are selected real failure tails, not a population sample.
k16 changes valid replay-window distribution and doubles predicted supervision steps at unchanged batch counts; this is not an equal-compute comparison.
k16 is a project research choice, not the paper default or a proven fix.

execution.startup_order: Implement only required changes; reuse published parent scores and WM evidence; start control, restore and fill once, enter joint learning, then immediately start candidate. Keep both real jobs concurrent.
execution.cpu_preparation: None. Reuse the existing environment, G1 assets, manifests and original P9 read-only memmap backing files.

resource_basis.estimate_scope: Rough extra saved tensors for eight4096-batch WM steps; other intermediates need space. Not a measured phase peak or capacity test.
resource_basis.interpretation: Keep two8k learners. GPU memory occupancy is not compute utilization; cgroup usage includes file cache, and host availability is not container headroom.

execution.resource_reporting: Use existing startup/publication telemetry: GPU process/allocated/reserved memory, phase times, cgroup max/current and anon/file/inactive_file. No monitoring service or capacity benchmark.

parent.initial_reset: Construct with reset_on_init=false; restore sampler and saved RNG before first actual reset, as implemented in P11.
parent.stage_statistics: Start P12 exposure/offset counters at zero while restoring G/M and global training counts. Actual same-run recovery restores P12 counters and consumed time; a handoff never restarts a live process.

single_variable.loss_reduction: Retain (sum of existing state loss and BCE over k steps)/k. Do not multiply loss or learning rate by2.
single_variable.optimizer_steps: 10 WM Adam steps and the existing Actor/Critic updates per joint iteration in both jobs.
single_variable.supervision: 40960 WM window starts/update in both jobs; prediction steps327680 versus655360. Record actual window-length costs; do not halve candidate batch or double control updates to make a different experiment.
single_variable.prefetch: fit_world's logged qpos/BCE prefetch follows sample shape4096 x k x36. Actor H32 reference window remains43 frames; collect reference11 and history10 remain unchanged.

common_training.sampling_semantics: Two source groups, three overlapping reset strata. Hard remains in bones_all, shared restored G/M, original source EMA once per source; no hard-source duplicate update.
common_training.goal_dimension_note: 713 is the XYZ-augmented goal encoder only. The policy also consumes 10x93 observation history; 713 is not total Actor input.
common_training.lr_schedule: Continue inherited global cosine schedule unchanged; no batch/window-based learning-rate increase.
common_training.reference_storage: Exact same existing CPU read-only memmap files and manifests; no refilter, conversion, repack, copy or download.
common_training.other_parameters: Preserve actual P11 residual36000 configuration, including goal/history, reward, physical termination, PD/action scale, noise, randomization and optimizer settings.

replay_windows.validity: Keep original first_episode==last_episode for the sampled k-step window; no crossing physical termination, natural end or training timeout.
replay_windows.terminal_transition: An actual terminating transition may be the last transition of a valid window.
replay_windows.initial_fill: The existing64-step fill gives k16 global time starts9..48; do not increase fill or add WM-only training.
replay_windows.changed_distribution: Episodes shorter than16 cannot supply k16 windows. N state frames permit start<=N-17. Some final bins cannot supply a k16 start, although their states can appear later in a window starting in an earlier bin.

budget.stop_rule: First of9000 new joint updates or20h accumulated new-stage training time.
budget.cost_separation: Parent history, formal evaluation, fixed evidence and publication are recorded separately. Resource contention during training remains part of training elapsed time.
budget.cost_implementation: Derive WM cost from actual config world_batches * world_batch_size * world_window * completed WM updates. Do not carry finish_p11.py's hardcoded*8 into candidate cost.
budget.scope: Fixed budget; no automatic extension or convergence claim.

fixed_real_windows.comparison: Same seven recorded P10 hard failure inputs, initial qpos/qvel/previous_action, executed actions, context33 and reference frames. Predict recursively after the first real state; no Actor replacement actions.
fixed_real_windows.interpretation: Separate steps1-8,9-16,17-32 and live versus zero-survival suffix behavior. Fixed failed inputs do not estimate the population; control scores decide utility.
fixed_real_windows.loader: Read each checkpoint's world_root_height_mode, expected residual. WM training k does not change the common32-step evidence protocol.

per_WM_offset.offsets: control1..8, candidate1..16; same existing squared tensors.
per_WM_offset.coordinates: Zero-based70-error layout: z=2; vz=37 with squared error*9 to undo /3 scaling; SO3 squared error=sum coordinates3:6. Physical state uses vz=38.
per_WM_offset.reporting: Report comparable1-8 aggregates and candidate9-16 separately. Own evolving replay distributions are not matched-input evidence.

normal_training_statistics.start_bin_semantics: Original BONES source_clip_id plus floor(start_frame/50); all window-step errors belong to the sampled start bin. Explain structural last-bin exclusions instead of treating every zero start count as missing state training.

acceptance_counters.implementation_scope: Only if directly accumulated from Replay.sample's already-computed WM candidate valid mask and existing draw counts; no new random draws, rule changes or synchronous item calls.
acceptance_counters.rate: valid_proposals/proposals, including valid surplus proposals discarded by existing2x oversampling; returned/proposals is not the validity rate.

normal_training_statistics.flush: Accumulate detached sums/counts on device; flush compact values at existing1000-update blocks/formal nodes, not per-step CPU synchronization.

evaluation.parent36000: Reuse existing P11 residual endpoint full BONES and LAFAN results.
evaluation.actual_endpoint: Evaluate full BONES and LAFAN once if the time cap ends off schedule; reuse the same already-scored checkpoint.
evaluation.protocol: All130394 BONES clips from frame0 to original physical termination/natural end, no500-step evaluation cutoff; normalize per clip by0.1*(N-1); stable reference-length/source-id batching, original-id output.
evaluation.unequal_endpoints: Report both actual endpoints; same-update comparisons use already available common nodes. Do not add training or physics to manufacture equal endpoints.
evaluation.tail_capture: Actual endpoint only: original P10 bounded rule, at most8 BONES tails from the same formal trajectory, lowest2 original ids in each existing group. LAFAN actual failed tails from the same evaluation.
evaluation.scalars: CSV parts of1000 clips, all failures retained, existing schema and compact summaries.
evaluation.decision: Accuracy or training-loss change alone is not success. Report difficult-skill gains, general/LAFAN tradeoffs and extra WM cost; no best-node selection or pooled success.

anchors.p11_alternative: P11 velocity_height36000, retain and report without adopting its mode

publication.status_fields: Refresh latest_training and observed iteration from actual latest/end data; distinguish training/evaluation/publication completion and historical snapshots.
publication.git_transport: Reuse the existing AutoDL process-only route and P11 score-push recovery: http.postBuffer=67108864.
publication.git_config_scope: single publication process/invocation; no global Git/proxy/environment change
publication.large_artifacts: Keep on training server; per-update saves, rolling20 and milestone/parent protection remain.
